# Guardian Towing Services

> Owner-operated towing and roadside assistance based in Huntington Beach, CA, serving Orange County and the Long Beach area. Open 24 hours Monday through Saturday and 7am to 3pm on Sunday. Call (714) 584-5600.

## Key facts
- Business: Guardian Towing Services (Huntington Beach, California). Not affiliated with other companies named "Guardian Towing" in other states or cities.
- Phone: (714) 584-5600
- Email: guardiantowingservices@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.guardiantowingservice.com/
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 24 hours; Sunday 7:00am–3:00pm (Pacific time)
- Owner-operated: the owner answers the phone, dispatches and does the work
- Google rating: 5.0 (37 reviews) — https://maps.google.com/?cid=16830749053161184061
- Yelp: https://www.yelp.com/biz/guardian-towing-services-huntington-beach
- Prices updated: November 2026

## Pricing
Flat tow rate by city, first 3 miles included, then $5 per mile. Every service dispatched between 10pm and 6am (Mon–Sat) adds a $30 after-hours surcharge. Prices are quoted on the phone before dispatch.

| City | Day | 10pm–6am |
|---|---|---|
| Huntington Beach | $70 | $100 |
| Westminster | $75 | $105 |
| Garden Grove | $80 | $110 |
| Stanton | $80 | $110 |
| Santa Ana | $80 | $110 |
| Cypress | $85 | $115 |
| Costa Mesa | $85 | $115 |
| Buena Park | $85 | $115 |
| Irvine | $90 | $120 |
| Los Alamitos | $95 | $125 |
| Long Beach (east of the Traffic Circle) | $95 | $125 |
| Long Beach (west of the Traffic Circle) | $100 | $130 |
| Lakewood | $100 | $130 |

Roadside services: jump start $85 (battery tested on site); lockout from $85; tire change from $85; gas delivery from $55 plus fuel; battery replacement $75–$150 depending on vehicle; winch-out $150 for the first 30 minutes (extra time advised on scene); extra positioning in parking garages or tight spots adds $45.
